---
applyTo: '**'
---
After you have implemented a feature, please follow these steps to ensure everything is working correctly:

1. Use get-problems tool to check for any errors in the code. If there are any errors, please fix them before proceeding. After you have fixed the errors, re-run the get-problems tool to ensure there are no remaining issues. After there are no errors, proceed to the next step "2".
2. Keep running ```cd vue-frontend && npm run build``` in a separate terminal to compile the frontend code.
3. If there is any error during the build process, please fix it and re-run the command until it completes successfully.
4. Once the build is successful, run the ```npm run lint``` command to check for any linting issues.
5. If there are any linting errors, please fix them and re-run the command until it completes without errors.
